item.title: After OVHcloud's Release Was Swapped: Three in Four Popular CLIs Could Be Too
item.author: xianpeng.shen@gmail.com (Xianpeng Shen)
item.description: On 19 October, the files in OVHcloud CLI releases were replaced with a credential stealer using a developer’s stolen credentials. I checked the latest release of 242 popular Go and Rust CLI projects: 179 could be swapped the same way, with nothing independent for a downloader to check. How I checked, why a checksum file doesn’t count, and three things maintainers can do.

item.title: GitHub AI Terminology Explained—Copilot, Agents, Models to MCP, Who is Who?
item.author: xianpeng.shen@gmail.com (Xianpeng Shen)
item.description: This article provides a detailed explanation of GitHub’s AI-related concepts and their hierarchical relationships through fact-based explanations and analogies, helping readers clarify the meaning and function of terms like Models, Agents, Spaces, and Spark.

item.title: My Patience with Accessing GitHub is Wearing Thin
item.author: xianpeng.shen@gmail.com (Xianpeng Shen)

item.title: Reliably Unforking a GitHub Repository Without Deletion and Reconstruction
item.author: xianpeng.shen@gmail.com (Xianpeng Shen)
